note: No permanent anonymous waiver (SP0001 §13.2). Every waiver needs an owner, reason, and expiry <= waiver_policy.max_lifetime_days. Scope strings match conformance signatures: 'forbidden:<cap>-><module>', 'effect:<module>:<target>', 'cycle:<cap>|<cap>|...'. The clean baseline needs zero waivers; this file exists so the mechanism is live and testable.
